summary: Star Equity Holdings filed an 8-K announcing that its common stock was added to the Russell Microcap Index after the 2026 Russell indexes reconstitution. The inclusion became effective after the U.S. market close on June 26, 2026. The filing includes a press release with commentary from CEO Jeff Eberwein. No specific deal terms or financial details are disclosed, as this is a routine index reconstitution event and does not constitute a special situation.
